item.title: Claude Code Best Practices: The One Constraint That Governs the Workflow
item.description: A Meituan-style decision walkthrough of Anthropic's Claude Code Best Practices: context is scarce currency, verification gates, Plan mode, CLAUDE.md/hooks, session isolation, and scale all answer the same meta-question.

item.title: Production-Grade AI Coding Patterns - 6 Reusable Engineering Practices
item.description: Six production-grade AI coding patterns extracted from Claude Code source code: Read Before Edit, Graduated Autonomy, Defensive Git, Structured Verification, Scope-Matched Response, and Tool-Level Prompts, plus the wisdom of dual-layer constraints.

item.title: Why Senior Rust Developers Never Use unwrap() And What They Do Instead
item.description: Senior Rust developers never use unwrap() in production code. Here's why and the proper error handling patterns with real examples.

item.title: Rust unsafe Done Right: 6 Common Misuses and How to Avoid Them
item.description: Rust's unsafe does not disable safety checks — it hands you the responsibility for 5 kinds of operations. Six runnable examples of common misuses: bypassing the borrow checker, dereferencing arbitrary raw pointers, violating borrow rules inside unsafe, reinventing wheels, abusing unsafe impl, and missing SAFETY comments.

item.title: Rust Ultimate Guide: 5 Trait & Generic Pitfalls That Will Make Your Colleagues 'Unreachable'
item.description: Deep dive into 5 common Rust Traits and Generics pitfalls, from generic overuse, trait constraint chaos, static vs dynamic dispatch confusion, associated types usage to struct constraint abuse. Master elegant and efficient Rust code.

item.title: Rust Error Handling: A Guide to Result, Option, unwrap(), and expect()
item.description: A deep dive into Rust's error handling mechanism, from the pitfalls of unwrap to the elegance of the ? operator. This guide covers core concepts like Result, Option, and panic handling with practical code examples and best practices to help you write safer, more reliable Rust code.
